DECLARE
 V_LOV BOOLEAN;
begin
 if :ctrl_block.site_id is not null 
 then
 select location_id
 ,rtrim(location_name)
 into :ctrl_block.site_id
 ,:ctrl_block.site_desc
 from locations
 where location_type = 'FIX'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id -- Added chapter_id as suggested by Celeste vide IM4879
 and (location_id = :ctrl_block.site_id
 or location_name like '%' ||:ctrl_block.site_id||'%')
 order by location_id;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found 
 then 
 show_error('11273'); -- Changed the error message from 11104 to 11273 as suggested by Celeste.
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others 
 then
 v_lov := show_lov('LOV_SITE_ID_CTRL');
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
end;

PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_data IS
chk boolean;
X number;
where_clause varchar2(700):= '';
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;
begin
 /*If :ctrl_block.term_check = 0 then
 Qrystring := Rtrim(Qrystring) || ' (Term_date is null or term_date >=sysdate)';
 Else
 Qrystring := Rtrim(Qrystring) || ' term_date is not null and term_date <= sysdate';
 End if; 
 if :ctrl_block.site_id is not null then
 set_block_property('fixed_site_attributes',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'site_id = :ctrl_block.site_id and ' ||' '|| rtrim(Qrystring)); 
 else
 set_block_property('fixed_site_attributes',DEFAULT_WHERE, Rtrim(Qrystring));
 end if; */
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 if :ctrl_block.term_check = 'Y' then
 where_clause := where_clause;
 elsif :ctrl_block.term_check = 'N' then
 where_clause := where_clause||' to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''dd-mon-yy'') between eff_date and nvl(term_date, ' ||'to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''dd-mon-yy'') +1)';
 end if;

 If :ctrl_block.site_id is not null then
 if where_clause is not null then
 where_clause := where_clause ||' and site_id = '||in_quotes(:ctrl_block.site_id) ;
 else
 where_clause := where_clause ||' site_id = '||in_quotes(:ctrl_block.site_id) ;
 end if; 
 End if;
 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL :=5;
 go_block('fixed_site_attributes');
 set_block_property('fixed_site_attributes',DEFAULT_WHERE,where_clause);
 execute_query;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL :=0;
 first_record;
 end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DUP_RECORD_CHECK IS
counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :FIXED_SITE_ATTRIBUTES.site_id is not null and
 :FIXED_SITE_ATTRIBUTES.sp_code is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM fixed_site_attributes
 WHERE site_id = :FIXED_SITE_ATTRIBUTES.site_id and
 sp_code = :FIXED_SITE_ATTRIBUTES.sp_code; 
 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 end if;
 end if; /* 1st if then */
 END IF;
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_SITE_ID
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct location_id,location_name from locations 
where location_type = 'FIX'
and to_date(to_char(:ctrl_block.ctrl_local_date,'mm/dd/yyyy'),'mm/dd/yyyy') between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(:ctrl_block.ctrl_local_date,'mm/dd/yyyy'),'mm/dd/yyyy') +1)
and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
and (location_id = :ctrl_block.site_id or location_name like '%' || :ctrl_block.site_id || '%')
order by 1
